text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 2: change in quantile score against climatology by lead. The dashed line is climatology (no change). More negative is better. Line: change. Shade: 98.75% interval from resampling the 12 months of the run. Farms A to F pooled.'
text.tspan: Figure 2: change in quantile score against climatology by lead. The dashed line is climatology (no change).
More negative is better. Line: change. Shade: 98.75% interval from resampling the 12 months of the run. Farms
